camel_example: aliyun cas ListCloudResources --region cn-hangzhou --CertIds '[14440149]' --Keyword 'cert-instanceId' --CurrentPage 1 --SecretId AK9600000006M --CloudName aliyun --ShowSize 20 --CloudProduct SLB
description_en: Queries the cloud resources on which certificates are deployed, such as Server Load Balancer (SLB) instances and CDN domains
description_zh: 您可以通过本接口获取云厂商及对应云产品的资源列表
kebab_example: aliyun cas list-cloud-resources --cloud-name aliyun --cloud-product SLB --secret-id AK9600000006M --keyword cert-instanceId --current-page 1 --show-size 20 --cert-ids 14440149 --api-version 2020-04-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCloudResources

parameters.help_en:
The cloud service provider.

Valid values:

Tencent

Huawei

Aws

aliyun
parameters.name: cloud_name

parameters.help_en:
The cloud service name. Used to filter resources by cloud service.

Valid values when CloudName is set to aliyun:

SLB: Classic Load Balancer (CLB). This value is available only on the China site (aliyun.com).

LIVE: ApsaraVideo Live. This value is available only on the China site (aliyun.com).

webHosting: Cloud Web Hosting. This value is available only on the China site (aliyun.com).

VOD: ApsaraVideo VOD. This value is available only on the China site (aliyun.com).

CR: Container Registry. This value is available only on the China site (aliyun.com).

DCDN: Dynamic Content Delivery Network (DCDN).

DDOS: Anti-DDoS.

CDN: Alibaba Cloud CDN (CDN).

ALB: Application Load Balancer (ALB).

APIGateway: API Gateway.

FC: Function Compute.

GA: Global Accelerator (GA).

MSE: Microservices Engine (MSE).

NLB: Network Load Balancer (NLB).

OSS: Object Storage Service (OSS).

SAE: Serverless App Engine (SAE).

WAF: Web Application Firewall (WAF).

Valid values when CloudName is set to Tencent:

TencentCDN: Content Delivery Network (CDN).

TencentCLB: CLB.

TencentWAF: WAF.

Valid value when CloudName is set to Huawei:

HuaweiCDN: CDN.

Valid values when CloudName is set to Aws:

AwsCloudFront: Amazon CloudFront.

AwsCLB: CLB.

AwsALB: ALB.

AwsNLB: NLB
parameters.help_zh:

SLB：传统型负载均衡 CLB（仅中国站）
LIVE：视频直播（仅中国站）
webHosting：云虚拟主机（仅中国站）
VOD：视频点播（仅中国站）
CR：容器镜像服务（仅中国站）
DCDN：全站加速
DDoS：DDos 防护
CDN：内容分发网络
ALB：应用负载均衡
APIGateway：API 网关
FC：函数计算
GA：全球加速
MSE：微服务引擎
NLB：网络型负载均衡
OSS：对象存储
SAE：Serverless 应用引擎
WAF：Web 应用防火墙

腾讯云：
TencentCDN：腾讯云 CDN
TencentCLB：腾讯云 负载均衡

华为云：

亚马逊：

AwsALB：亚马逊 ALB

parameters.name: cloud_product

parameters.help_en: The AccessKey ID that is used to access cloud resources
parameters.help_zh: 根据云资源访问密钥ID过滤
parameters.name: secret_id

parameters.help_en: The keyword of the domain name or instance ID bound to the cloud resource
parameters.help_zh: 根据云资源绑定域名或实例ID关键字过滤

parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。默认值为1

parameters.help_en: The certificate IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.name: cert_ids

Data.description_en: The data returned for the request

CertEndTime.description_en: The end date of the certificate bound to the cloud resource. The value is a timestamp in seconds
CertEndTime.description_zh: 云产品资源绑定证书的结束日期（秒，时间戳格式）
CertEndTime.title_en: 云资源绑定证书结束日期
CertEndTime.title_zh: 云资源绑定证书结束日期

CertId.description_en: The ID of the certificate bound to the cloud resource
CertId.description_zh: 云产品资源绑定的证书ID

CertName.description_en: The name of the certificate bound to the cloud resource
CertName.description_zh: 云产品资源绑定的证书名称

CertStartTime.description_en: The start date of the certificate bound to the cloud resource. The value is a timestamp in seconds
CertStartTime.description_zh: 云产品资源绑定证书的开始日期（秒，时间戳格式）
CertStartTime.title_en: 云资源绑定证书开始日期
CertStartTime.title_zh: 云资源绑定证书开始日期

CloudAccessId.description_en:
The AccessKey ID that is used to access cloud resources.

This parameter is returned only when you deploy certificates to cloud services of third-party clouds
CloudAccessId.description_zh:
云资源集访问的密钥ID。
仅多云部署才会返回该参数

CloudName.description_en:
The cloud service provider.

Valid values:

Tencent

Huawei

Aws

aliyun

CloudRegion.description_en: The region ID of the cloud service provider to which the cloud resource belongs
CloudRegion.description_zh: 云产品资源在云供应商的地域ID

DefaultResource.description_en:
Indicates whether the cloud resource is the default resource. Valid values:

1: yes

0: no

This parameter is returned only when the value of CloudProduct is SLB, NLB, ALB, or GA
DefaultResource.description_zh:
云产品资源是否为默认资源。
1：默认资源
0：非默认资源
仅部署SLB、NLB、ALB和GA才会返回该参数
DefaultResource.title_en: 云资源是否为默认资源
DefaultResource.title_zh: 云资源是否为默认资源

Domain.description_en: The domain name bound to the cloud resource
Domain.description_zh: 云产品资源绑定的域名

EnableHttps.description_en:
Indicates whether HTTPS is enabled for the cloud resource. Valid values:

1: yes.

0: no
EnableHttps.description_zh:
云产品资源是否开启HTTPS。
1：开启
0：未开启

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the cloud resource was created. The time is a timestamp in seconds
GmtCreate.description_zh: 同步资源创建时间（秒，时间戳格式）

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the cloud resource was last modified. The time is a timestamp in seconds
GmtModified.description_zh: 同步资源最近一次修改时间（秒，时间戳格式）

Id.description_en: The ID of the cloud resource

InstanceId.description_en:
The instance ID of the cloud resource.

This parameter is returned only when the value of CloudProduct is SLB, NLB, ALB, or GA
InstanceId.description_zh:
云产品资源实例ID。
仅部署SLB、NLB、ALB和GA才会返回该参数

ListenerId.description_en:
The listener ID of the cloud resource.

This parameter is returned only when the value of CloudProduct is SLB, NLB, ALB, or GA
ListenerId.description_zh:
云产品资源监听ID。
仅部署SLB、NLB、ALB和GA才会返回该参数

ListenerPort.description_en:
The listening port of the cloud resource.

This parameter is returned only when the value of CloudProduct is SLB, NLB, ALB, or GA
ListenerPort.description_zh:
云产品资源监听端口。
仅部署SLB、NLB、ALB和GA才会返回该参数

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the cloud resource
RegionId.description_zh: 同步的云产品资源地域ID

Status.description_en: The status of the cloud resource
Status.description_zh: 同步的云产品资源状态

UseSsl.description_en:
Indicates whether an Alibaba Cloud SSL certificate is used. Valid values:

1: yes

0: no

This parameter is required only when you deploy certificates to services of multiple clouds
UseSsl.description_zh:
是否使用阿里云SSL证书。
1：使用
0：未使用
仅多云部署才会返回该参数

UserId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

ShowSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20
ShowSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含资源的数量。默认值为20

Total.description_en: The total number of entries returned
